name: Wardrobe validates only changed slots, so an active set does not block other transmogs (#11003, #8897)
contract: Extensions.dll ApplyPendingAppearances validates only the categories the player changed, then sends the
whole pending array in CMSG_APPLY_APPEARANCES (0x0697); unchanged slots carry the current active appearance.
The server must not reject a request because an unchanged, already active slot fails a check that a new
selection would fail. Appearances.dbc row 17650 is the Hexflame Coven item set (category 55); its pieces
3162-3174 all have categories (1, 0, 0) and ExpandItemSetAppearance stores them by InventoryType in slots
1-11, so shoulder appearance 3163 is active in category 2. Resending that array with a new thrown
appearance 12001 (category 12) must be accepted, not answered with APPLY_APPEARANCES_INVALID_CATEGORY.
A relog reads character_appearance back through SMSG_APPEARANCE_ACTIVE_INFO (opcode 1690; word category+1)
to show the new slot was saved and the set pieces kept. CoA.UnlockLocalAppearanceCatalog collects every
appearance, so the reports' uncollected active slots cannot be fixtured; they take the same unchanged path.

steps.label: The weapon request receives one response
Unchanged set slots do not reject the new weapon appearance
The thrown appearance is saved in category 12
The set shoulders stay in category 2
The set selection stays in category 55
